article.headline: Delgardo scores 20, North Carolina A&T downs Morgan State 82-70
article.description: — Danny Delgardo III had 20 points in North Carolina A&T’s 82-70 victory over Morgan State on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Delgardo scores 20, North Carolina A&T downs Morgan State 82-70

categories.description: Morgan State Bears @ North Carolina A&T Aggies

event.description: Morgan State Bears @ North Carolina A&T Aggies

keywords: Morgan State Bears @ North Carolina A&T Aggies
article.story: GREENSBORO, N.C. -- — Danny Delgardo III had 20 points in North Carolina A&T’s 82-70 victory over Morgan State on Wednesday. Delgardo added five rebounds for the Aggies (3-2). Will Felton added 18 points while going 5 of 12 and 8 of 12 from the free-throw line and had 13 rebounds. Alfred Worrell Jr. finished with 19 points, six rebounds and two steals for the Bears (4-2). Jeremiah Kwarteng added 14 points for Morgan State. Ibi Traore finished with 10 points. N.C. A&T took the lead with 5:58 left in the first half and did not trail again. Felton led the team in scoring with 14 points in the first half to help put them up 44-34 at the break. N.C. A&T outscored Morgan State in the second half by two points, with Delgardo scoring a team-high seven points after intermission. Up next N.C. A&T plays Monday against South Carolina State on the road, and Morgan State hosts Cornell on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
